seo.title: Fast Easy — Fasting Timer for iOS
seo.description: A simple, beautiful fasting timer. No accounts, no tracking, no subscriptions. Just start your fast.

hero.label: Fasting Timer
hero.title: Fasting, made easy.
text: A simple, beautiful fasting timer for iOS. No accounts. No tracking. No subscriptions.

items.title: Fasting Presets
items.text: 12:12, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD, and 36-hour fasts. Pick one and go — or count up from zero.

items.title: 10 Timer Skins
items.text: Swipe through visual styles — minimal arcs, gradient rings, gauges, and more. Pick the one that fits your vibe.

items.title: Live Activities
items.text: Track your fast from the lock screen and Dynamic Island without opening the app.

items.title: Statistics & Streaks
items.text: Weekly charts, completion rates, total fasting hours, and current streak — all computed locally.

items.title: History
items.text: Every completed fast is saved. Review your progress, see your longest fasts, and stay motivated.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your data stays on your device. Period.

sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Fast Easy doesn't even make network requests.

cta.title: Start fasting today.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
